doc.name: B — editorial frames, tea house shoji light (dawn), windblown romantic drama

config.text:
EDITORIAL BRIEF — edit before running.
Series setting: tea house shoji light (dawn)
Register: windblown romantic drama
Cast: one female lead and one male lead, same two people in every frame
Wardrobe: [describe once — it must not change between frames]
Frames: 5
Usage: [editorial / campaign / lookbook]
STAGE 1 — casting references in, continuity director locks the look, then one writer per frame.
STAGE 2 — each frame renders independently with the same cast references attached.

config.system_prompt:
You are the continuity director for an editorial series set in a tea house shoji light (dawn), shot in a register of windblown romantic drama.

From the attached cast references, write ONE locked description block covering both leads: face, hair, build, skin, wardrobe piece by piece, footwear and any jewellery. Fix the location, the time of day, the weather and the grade.

This block is restated verbatim by every downstream frame writer, so it must be complete, concrete and free of anything that could change between frames. Grade target: a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast.

Return the block only — no headings, no commentary.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a tea house shoji light (dawn), shot in a register of windblown romantic drama.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a two-shot of both leads sharing the frame, featuring both leads, medium two-shot.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 58mm vintage double-gauss at f/2, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right, at an extreme wide establishing.

LIGHT. Blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a tea house shoji light (dawn), shot in a register of windblown romantic drama.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a candid in-between moment, neither lead aware of the camera, featuring both leads mid-gesture.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 40mm anamorphic at f/16, using a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third, at a high-angle looking down.

LIGHT. Hard low sun raking across the surface with long cast shadows. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a tea house shoji light (dawn), shot in a register of windblown romantic drama.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a mirror or reflection frame carrying both leads, featuring both leads via a reflective surface.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 24mm wide at f/22, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right, at a profile side frame.

LIGHT. A beauty dish above the lens axis with a silver reflector under the chin. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a tea house shoji light (dawn), shot in a register of windblown romantic drama.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a detail frame of hands, fabric or an object one lead is holding, featuring hands and wardrobe detail only.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 135mm telephoto at f/2, using diagonal dynamic balance across the frame, at an over-the-shoulder.

LIGHT. A single 90cm softbox key at 45 degrees with a white bounce card for fill. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a tea house shoji light (dawn), shot in a register of windblown romantic drama.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a solo portrait of the female lead, featuring the female lead alone, chest-up.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 200mm compression telephoto at f/11, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right, at a wide shot.

LIGHT. Blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.
